title: It works, BUT...
text: It works, BUT.... This kit came with no instructions, which shouldn't be that big of a deal if it is self-explanatory to use. However I found myself wondering if I did it wrong because I was having a hard time getting the adhesive to keep it on. I see now from other reviews that I'm not the only one, which makes me feel better about it. Perhaps we're all doing it wrong and someone who knows how to do this better will have a better experience? Maybe they should have included some basic instructions? All I know is that it seems to work when the insulating strip stays on, but you might need to use your own adhesive to make that happen.
